name_zh: 中国共产党一大•二大•四大纪念馆景区
address_zh: 中共一大会址位于上海市兴业路76号、中共二大会址位于上海老成都北路7弄30号、中共四大纪念馆坐落于上海市虹口区四川北路绿地公园内
address_en: The site of the First Congress of the Communist Party of China is located at No. 76 Xingye Road, Shanghai. The site of the Second Congress of the Communist Party of China is located at No. 30, Lane 7, Old Chengdu North Road, Shanghai. The Memorial Hall of the Fourth National Congress of the Communist Party of China is located in the Greenland Park of Sichuan North Road, Hongkou District, Shanghai.
intro_zh: 中共“一大”原址是两栋砖木结构的两层石库门楼房，一栋是一大代表李汉俊的家宅，另一栋是一大代表在上海的住所--博文女校。中共“二大”会址是始建于1915年的石库门民居，曾是时任中央局宣传主任李达的寓所。中共“四大”原址于一二八事变中毁于战火，2006年异地重建了纪念馆，纪念馆由序厅、主展厅、影视厅和副展厅等组成。
intro_en: The Communist Party of China (CPC), commonly known as the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), is the founding and sole governing party of the People's Republic of China (PRC). Founded in 1921, the CCP won the Chinese Civil War against the Kuomintang and proclaimed the establishment of the PRC under the chairmanship of Mao Zedong in October 1949. The CCP has since governed China and has had absolute control over the country's armed forces and law enforcement. As of 2025, the CCP has more than 101 million members, making it the second largest political party by membership in the world. In 1921, Chen Duxiu and Li Dazhao founded the CCP with the help of the Far Eastern Bureau of the Russian Communist Party (Bolsheviks) and Far Eastern Bureau of the Communist International. Although the CCP aligned with the Kuomintang (KMT) during its initial years, the rise of the KMT's right-wing under the leadership of Chiang Kai-shek and subsequent massacres of tens of thousands of CCP members resulted in a split and a prolonged civil war between the CCP and KMT.
